why: No major reviewer or authority answers the question. The Synology PDFs returned no text, and Tom's Hardware is an off-target ransomware story. The rest are affiliate roundups and untested niche guides that mention cheap Synology boxes or Hyper Backup in passing. None covers the off-site second-NAS setup. A focused page with current prices, a direct pick and setup steps would stand out.
